grades.quote: When the TLB refill exception is triggered, the hardware records the old value of the IE field in the CSR.CRMD in this field.
grades.reason: Describes TLBRPRMD (the TLB-refill-specific analogue), not PRMD. It shows the same save/restore pattern for PPLV/PIE, but only for TLB refill exceptions, so it is auxiliary at best.

grades.quote: Otherwise, the hardware restores the value of the PIE field of CSR.PRMD to here.
grades.reason: Gives part of the restore side. On ERTN in the ordinary case, the hardware restores PRMD.PIE into CRMD.IE. It also notes that IE is cleared on exception entry. It does not cover PPLV or the saving of state into PRMD.

grades.quote: Store `PLV` and `IE` in `CSR.CRMD` to `PPLV` and `PIE` in `CSR.PRMD` , then set `PLV` in `CSR.CRMD` to `0` and `IE` to `0`
grades.reason: Directly answers both parts. On entry, CRMD PLV and IE are saved to PRMD PPLV and PIE, and PLV and IE are then cleared. On ERTN, PPLV and PIE are restored to PLV and IE.
Describes the MERRSAVE data save register. It says nothing about PRMD, PPLV, or PIE.
